title: Julie NDE 3112
content: I had been horseback riding at my grandfather's house. I dismounted to open a gate to return to the house. As I closed the gate and turned toward my horse a bee flew at her eye. My horse spun around toward me, she hit me square in the face with her head. I didn't know how badly I was injured, my face felt numb. I was afraid to open my mouth, even though I needed to spit out blood. I feared my teeth might fall out. I mounted my horse and rode a short distance to my grandfather's house. He and a friend were sitting to the left of the house in lawn chairs under a tree. I tied my horse behind the house, wiped the blood from my face with my shirt. I waved at them as if nothing was really wrong. I wondered if my grandfather would wonder why I didn't stop to talk with them. I walked from the back of the house to the front door. I went in the bathroom and looked in the mirror. I checked my teeth. They were a little loose. My nose was bleeding. I washed my face off, and got a wet towel. I walked down the hall and sat on the side of the bed. I was feeling very light headed. I remember fainting and lying back on the bed with my feet on the floor. The next thing I remember is being on the ceiling looking down at my body. This did not frighten me; it was just 'okay'. I didn't think this was strange. My thoughts were light not deep. It was very peaceful everywhere. I felt very safe and secure. I could hear the birds outside. I was aware of everything around me. Yet, I was at the ceiling looking down at my body. I heard my grandfather come in the front door. I heard the door close. He called my name. When he saw me on the bed, he yelled my name. He began shaking me violently by my shoulders. He was crying and asking me what happened. I could feel his fear, but I had none. The next thing I remember is just seeing him above when I awoke. He rushed me to the hospital. He talked to me all the way, and held my hand. I talked very little. My experience was all I could think about. I was uncertain of what had happened to me. My injuries were slight. A small crack on the side of my nose. My teeth tightened in a few days. He told the doctor I was blue and had no pulse and was not breathing when he found me. The doctor said I had gone into shock. I was okay - knew I would never be the same. I didn't tell anyone about this for several years.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Horse hit her in the face (horse spun after a bee flew at its eye); she fainted afterward.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE occurred during fainting; no tunnel/light/life review/boundary described; then returned to body and awoke to grandfather above her.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: During the OBE she reported hearing birds outside and hearing her grandfather enter, call her name, and then shake her body; she reported feeling his fear while she had none.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “The next thing I remember is being on the ceiling looking down at my body.” “This did not frighten me; it was just 'okay'.” “It was very peaceful everywhere. I felt very safe and secure.” “He told the doctor I was blue and had no pulse and was not breathing when he found me.” “I was okay - knew I would never be the same.”
